definitions.seam: full derivative stencil intersects two source-window owners
definitions.free: every derivative support frame is free-flight
definitions.local_error: five-frame centered box trend; only within same window, all support frames free; derivatives use seven original frames

definitions.sample_spread: each sample minus sample mean; derivative squared energy is orthogonal to mean energy
